characters.name: Devika Rao
characters.profile: Prepared the result packet and handled the final score summary. She says she was stuck at the covered loading bay during the rain and did not enter the judges' corridor after 3:10 PM.

characters.name: Arjun Mehta
characters.profile: Managed stage timing and says he was on the main stage rehearsing the award announcement from 3:18 to 3:36 PM.

characters.name: Farah Khan
characters.profile: Carried documents between the judges and the event office. She says she delivered the original signed summary to the judges' office at 3:12 PM and did not retrieve it afterward.

characters.name: Nikhil Verma
characters.profile: Worked near the loading bay and checked a power distribution unit after rainwater was reported near the outer cable cover.

characters.name: Isha Reddy
characters.profile: Managed the registration desk and used the office printer for badge reprints. She says she did not enter the judges' corridor that afternoon.

characters.name: Kabir Shah
characters.profile: Had challenged the preliminary tie-break result on behalf of his team. He says he remained in the public waiting area and did not have staff access.

characters.name: Judge Leena
characters.profile: The Aster category judge who signed the original tie-break note.

characters.name: Event secretary
characters.profile: Keeps the results record and the incident note.
